marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The icy incident: "It was an icy cold day, and the weather was forecasted to get even colder. King Wordy and Queen Scribble wanted to make sure that all the Alphabet monsters are warmly wrapped up. While Alice, Brian and Cherry Berry assembled the ABC monsters, they found that I-monster was missing. So by using the first clue from the ABC book, they started on a mission to find him."--Container. Jumping jesters: "Cherry Berry wanted to enter the Jester Jamboree and perform something that nobody has ever seen before. She was really worried because she couldn't think of any act yet, and maybe she won't be joining after all. However, things got worse when they discovered that J-monster had gone missing."
